queue.excerpt: The Freightliner Cascadia sleeper tractor is outfitted with Hexagon Agility’s back-of-cab and side-mount CNG fuel systems with a combined capacity equivalent to 265 gallons of diesel.

queue.title: Fuel surcharges push truckload rates higher as shipment volumes edge higher
queue.excerpt: While freight demand continues to inch back, fuel surcharges drove truckload rates higher in September. The Cass Freight Index’s shipments component rose 2.3% month over month and 1.9% year over year in September, the second straight annual gain after a 3.5-year downturn — the longest on record.…
